findings.evidence: `rg --files code/TauCeti/Geometry/Symplectic | rg 'Lagrangian(Prod|Transport|Graph|Constructions)\.lean$'` returns only `LagrangianConstructions.lean`; the moved declarations are now at `LagrangianConstructions.lean:68`, `:139`, and `:244`.
findings.fix: Keep compatibility shim modules at the old paths, each importing the new module or otherwise re-exporting the moved declarations, or document and justify the breaking module API change.

summary: The declarations were moved, but the PR deletes three previously importable public modules, breaking downstream imports for a file-boundary-only refactor.
